about_item: ORTHOPEDIC FOAM DOG BED: This dog couch is made of orthopedic egg foam, the thick dog bed helps cushion pressure points, and supports the dog's joints and muscles evenly. Therefore the orthopedic dog beds can ease the discomfort of anxious older dogs, and dogs with arthritis and promote better sleep at night.

L-SHAPED DOG BED: This X large dog bed adopts L shaped design, the dog beds Soft and comfortable rails provide extra support for our pet's head and neck, and the dog sofa bed has no railings on two sides, providing plenty of room for pets to stretch out. The dog beds for large dogs allow pets to be more soothed and relaxed and to fall into a deep sleep.

SOFT SURFACE&WATERPROOF: The surface of the large dog beds is made of soft and cozy high-quality fluff. The pet bed is pleasant to the touch, non-pilling, and gentle on sensitive dogs' skin, noses, and paws. There is a waterproof layer in the dog couch bed mezzanine cover to prevent liquids from dampening the egg foam.

SIZE(DOG BEDS FOR LARGE DOGS): The dimensions of this L dog bed are 36.0"L x 27.0"W x 3"Th. Large dog beds for large dogs up to 55 lbs. If you want more space for your pet, it is recommended to choose a larger size dog bed.

EASY TO CLEAN&NON-SLIP: The sofa dog bed comes with a removable and washable dog pillow cover to ensure that the big dog bed can be easily cleaned. The washable dog bed has a durable zipper that allows for easy removal and reattachment. The non-slip rubber particles of the waterproof dog bed bottom hold it in place on the floor without sliding.

summary.text: Customers find the dog bed to be of good quality, comfortable, and soft with a firm cushion, and appreciate that it's easy to wash by removing the cover. The bed is recommended for dogs of all ages and offers good value for money. Regarding size, while some find it perfect for large breeds, others say it's smaller than advertised. Durability receives mixed feedback, with some saying it holds up well while others report issues with the bolster seams coming apart after a month.

other_countries_reviews.title: Good quality product.
other_countries_reviews.text: I ordered this for Percy M., my senior Jack Russell Terrier who was struggling with hip dysplasia. He is 15 years old and has slept on the bed for most of his life. The inner foam is wonderful, just as comfortable as a human mattress. The bolsters are super helpful for extra support. The outer casing is sewn with good-quality material, and it's easy to remove and wash out. This is a wonderful product for older dogs.
